name: DefenderBench
intro: DefenderBench 是一个开源网络安全智能体评测工具包，按五类任务组织网络入侵、恶意内容、CTI 问答、漏洞检测和漏洞修复，并在论文表格中汇总为八个报告列。
build_method: 上游公开数据按任务下载与缓存, 固定种子筛选抽样, 模块化交互环境, 论文与 loader 差异标注
metric: 2 项入侵接管比例, 5 项宏平均 F1, CodeBLEU, DefB = 8 列百分数算术平均；每项 5 次运行取均值
task_type: Agent任务, 分类, 代码生成, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 五类任务与八个报告列分离, 入侵最多 100 步, 静态任务最多 5 次总尝试且首答计入, 发布实现漂移说明
scale: 5 类任务、8 个报告列；多数测试池 500 例，CVEFIX 240 例；当前 CG/DV 两列共享同一 500 行子集
task_type_en: Agent Task, Classification, Code Generation, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Task-wise Upstream Download/Cache, Fixed-seed Filtering and Sampling, Modular Environments, Paper/loader Drift Annotation
eval_feature_en: Five Task Types vs Eight Report Columns, 100-step Intrusion, Five Total Static-task Attempts Including the First Answer, Release-drift Caveats
intro_en: DefenderBench is an open-source cybersecurity-agent evaluation toolkit organized into five task types—network intrusion, malicious content, CTI MCQA, vulnerability detection, and vulnerability fixing—and summarized as eight report columns in the paper.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.00739v4 §§3–5, Tables 1–2, and pinned implementation evidence: microsoft/DefenderBench@e431098e217ee6778f572df202785f1a705df167; CyberBattleSim@854d6966607fb68645651f55b0f97221bd293e0d; phishing@55caf9af01ae498d68ff44886ff69a4b165eb54b; CTI-Bench@9237e1636ee3e168fbe5ebdcc1c571de0525e568; CodeXGLUE@69bd48c03223c2104342acd9a807caf61ac3efb8; Semeru/Devign@c8cbfeecf4090a18678384c559102a68bfa00829; and CVEfixes Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13118970 v1.0.8, MD5 4586a358977acfa4c60b1a2cdd096221. The toolkit has no frozen consolidated dataset bundle, so upstream downloads can drift. The diagram preserves five task types and eight report columns. Chain10/ToyCTF6 use three actions and at most 100 steps. Malicious text has 20,137 rows; malicious web has 15,612 after removing 144 short pages. Paper intent is 500 test plus 10 ICL per class, but the pinned web few-shot loader has a confirmed bug that selects positive examples for both pools. CTI is 2,500 → 2,338 → 500 test + 20 ICL; the paper says inaccessible links are removed, while released code only checks that the URL contains http. The CG and DV columns load the same Devign-derived corpus and, under the same seed, produce the same 500-row subset rather than 1,000 independent examples. CVEFix filtering reduces 12,107 commits / 4,249 projects to eight languages × 30 = 240, with additional repository filters beyond the paper summary. Static episodes allow at most five total answer attempts: the first answer counts as attempt one, and invalid formats receive feedback before a retry. The two intrusion values are nodes-taken / total-nodes takeover fractions; five static columns use Macro-F1 and CVEFix uses CodeBLEU weights 0.1/0.1/0.4/0.4. DefB is a paper-table aggregation, sum of eight percentage columns divided by eight; the official runner does not compute that terminal score. Each evaluation experiment is independently run five times and averaged.
